meta.notes: Hodgdon-family product pages are on shop.hodgdon.com, which is blocked from this sandbox; Hodgdon/IMR/Winchester records therefore come from: the 2026 relative burn-rate chart (names, order, status=current), brand-page featured-product one-liners (applications; "ball powder" -> form spherical), the Winchester "Staball family" statement, the IMR "Enduron" statement, the 2012 Hodgdon Extreme-series web printout (form extruded, temperature claims), and the OCR'd COVER PAGE of each scanned Hodgdon SDS (title such as "Spherical Powders"/"Extruded Rifle Powders"/"Double Base Powders"/"Single Base Powders" and the product names listed). Evidence strings from OCR are prefixed "[OCR]". Numeric composition in the scanned SDS was NOT extracted (OCR digits unreliable; tables keyed by internal codes). Alliant records come from www.alliantpowder.com product pages, Alliant SDS PDFs (Section 3 nitroglycerin bands, Section 9 appearance) and the 2023 Reloader's Guide. nitroglycerinPct is set only where a single figure is stated (Alliant guide p.10: Bullseye 40 %, American Select 2 %). nitroglycerinPctRange holds SDS family bands (not product-specific). baseBasis="sds-composition" means base was inferred from the SDS listing nitroglycerin with lowest band >= 4 % together with Alliant's own definition of double-base; "stated" means a page says it. temperatureStableClaim is verbatim maker text (not a boolean). applications are categories (rifle/handgun/shotshell/muzzleloader) derived by keyword from maker text; principalUse/secondaryUse/guideUse hold the raw text. bulkDensityGcc, heatOfExplosionJg and grainDimensions are null everywhere: none of these documents publish them. burnRateRanks positions are chart positions, not quantitative burn rates. fieldEvidence maps each populated field to the verbatim lines it came from.
